topic: Proof of Snell's Law: The Principle of Least Time

sections.title: Introduction: Fermat's Principle
lecture_lines: Light travels the path of least time.
A lifeguard on sand runs faster than swimming.
They choose an angled path to save time.

lecture_lines: Total time is sum of travel times.
